description: Election Commission - Lists of recognized Political Partys for Parliamentary Elections
reasoning: This gazette content is a notice under Section 7(4)(b) of the Parliamentary Elections Act, No. 1 of 1981, published by the Commissioner General of Elections. It specifically lists the political parties recognized for election purposes by the Election Commission. This falls directly under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which includes electoral commission decisions, candidate/party registrations, and other electoral process matters.
